title: The Wild Oath
author: W. M. Winterbourne
blurb: Theo Dunmore, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
